environment: Mac offline simulation, no vehicle connection
controller_candidate: y55 plus rule correction to 1.00 m beam spacing

limitations: Targets at 1560-1600 are extrapolated asymptotic parameters, not measured terminal speeds.

The 1560 target and time constant hit their search bounds; its separate response is poorly identified. 1555,1575,1580,1585,1590 have insufficient straight-segment observations and need interpolation/uncertainty scenarios.
No lateral tire identification. No layout/controller tuning.
Snapshots and IMU speed drift constrain accuracy. The exit segment bends, so uncorrected rear rays are excluded as displacement reference.
Finish IMU speed integration and independent front-wall displacement differ by up to ~0.33 m on y53; retain that model uncertainty before inferring stopping accuracy.

caveat: Scenario counts are not success probabilities. No lateral identification or real outdoor detector validation was performed.
